policy.zh: 每条简介只依据对应组织记录中的类型、类别、重点方向、纳入理由与官方证据生成；不推断具体产品、在招岗位、签证或赞助承诺。
policy.en: Each profile is generated only from that organization’s recorded type, categories, focus areas, relevance note, and official evidence; it does not infer specific products, live openings, visas, or sponsorship commitments.

synopsys.descriptionZh: 新思科技作为上市公司收录于组织树，核心范围集中在电子设计自动化（EDA）、工程仿真、半导体知识产权（IP）、面向电子设计自动化的人工智能（AI for EDA）。其已记录的关注点包括数字设计、验证、物理设计、多物理与智能体工程；本简介以所引来源为依据。
synopsys.descriptionEn: Synopsys is cataloged as a public company centered on Electronic Design Automation (EDA), Engineering Simulation, Semiconductor Intellectual Property (Semiconductor IP), and AI for Electronic Design Automation (AI for EDA). Its documented areas of attention include digital design, verification, physical design, multiphysics, and agentic engineering; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
synopsys.relevanceZh: 筛选新思科技时，可先用 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、AI 辅助 EDA、CAD 工程作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“AI Agent 结合 EDA、验证、物理设计自动化及 Virtuoso 相关工作流程的直接匹配。”
synopsys.relevanceEn: When screening Synopsys, use EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, AI for EDA, and CAD Engineering as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Direct match for AI/Agent plus EDA, verification, physical-design automation and Virtuoso-adjacent workflows.”

cadence.descriptionZh: 楷登电子是上市公司，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括电子设计自动化（EDA）、半导体知识产权（IP）、面向电子设计自动化的人工智能（AI for EDA）、系统分析。已列出的技术重点包括集成电路设计、验证、3D 集成电路、PCB 和计算软件；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cadence.descriptionEn: Cadence Design Systems is a public company whose recorded scope includes Electronic Design Automation (EDA), Semiconductor Intellectual Property (Semiconductor IP), AI for Electronic Design Automation (AI for EDA), and System Analysis. Its listed technical focus includes IC design, verification, 3D-IC, PCB, and computational software; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cadence.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，楷登电子最直接的能力对应方向是 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、AI 辅助 EDA、CAD 工程。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“完整的硅到系统组合与 Virtuoso、RTL、验证和自动化经验高度匹配。”
cadence.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at Cadence Design Systems, the most direct capability matches are EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, AI for EDA, and CAD Engineering. The recorded rationale states: “Full silicon-to-systems portfolio closely matches Virtuoso, RTL, verification and automation experience.”

siemens-eda.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies Siemens EDA as a public-company business unit active in Electronic Design Automation (EDA), Industrial Software, Engineering Simulation, and AI for Electronic Design Automation (AI for EDA). More specifically, it points to verification, IC implementation, DFT, PCB, and simulation, supported by the cited source.
siemens-eda.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与西门子 EDA 之间最强的连接位于 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、AI 辅助 EDA、CAD 工程。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“将半导体 EDA、验证与 Altair 仿真、高性能计算整合在同一母公司体系内。”

Its documented areas of attention include RF EDA, high-speed design, test automation, and measurement software; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
keysight-technologies.relevanceZh: 筛选是德科技时，可先用 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、CAD 工程、设计流程工程作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“连接 EDA 软件、射频、系统分析和自动化硬件验证的强大桥梁。”

The existing record gives this rationale: “Strong bridge between EDA software, RF/system analysis and automated hardware validation.”

silvaco.descriptionZh: Silvaco 作为上市公司收录于组织树，核心范围集中在电子设计自动化（EDA）、工艺与器件计算机辅助设计（TCAD）、半导体知识产权（IP）。其已记录的关注点包括 TCAD、定制集成电路、物理验证与半导体知识产权；本简介以所引来源为依据。

pdf-solutions.descriptionZh: 组织树将 PDF Solutions 归类为覆盖半导体分析、电子设计自动化（EDA）、半导体良率、人工智能（AI）的上市公司。其记录中的技术重点是良率分析、制造数据、设计检验和人工智能分析，本简介以所引来源为依据。
pdf-solutions.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies PDF Solutions as a public company with activity in Semiconductor Analytics, Electronic Design Automation (EDA), Semiconductor Yield, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). Its recorded technical focus is yield analytics, manufacturing data, design-for-inspection, and AI analytics, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
pdf-solutions.relevanceZh: PDF Solutions 之所以属于目标组织全集，在于 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、CAD 工程、设计流程工程与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“半导体领域数据、自动化和人工智能的良好交汇，而非纯粹的 RTL 竞争。”
pdf-solutions.relevanceEn: PDF Solutions belongs in the target universe where EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, CAD Engineering, and Design Flow Engineering intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Good intersection of semiconductor domain data, automation and AI rather than pure RTL competition.”

Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “Niche verification vendor where RTL semantics and automation matter more than generic coding alone.”

The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Strong fit for RISC-V/SoC verification, automation and coverage-driven thinking.”

The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Excellent niche for HDL semantics, parsers and reliable automation.”

imagination-technologies.descriptionZh: Imagination Technologies 作为私营企业收录于组织树，核心范围集中在半导体知识产权（IP）、图形处理器（GPU）、RISC-V 开放指令集架构。其已记录的关注点包括 GPU IP、RISC-V CPU 和 AI 加速；本简介以所引来源为依据。
imagination-technologies.descriptionEn: Imagination Technologies is cataloged as a private company centered on Semiconductor Intellectual Property (Semiconductor IP), Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), and RISC-V. Its documented areas of attention include GPU IP, RISC-V CPU, and AI acceleration; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
imagination-technologies.relevanceZh: 筛选 Imagination Technologies 时，可先用 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“与架构、RTL、DV 和图形、AI IP 相关；美国的机会量需要验证。”
imagination-technologies.relevanceEn: When screening Imagination Technologies, use RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Relevant to architecture, RTL/DV and graphics/AI IP; US opportunity volume requires verification.”

mips.descriptionZh: 组织树将美普思科技归类为覆盖半导体知识产权（IP）、RISC-V 开放指令集架构、中央处理器（CPU）的私营企业。其记录中的技术重点是 RISC-V 处理器、嵌入式计算和汽车计算，本简介以所引来源为依据。
mips.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies MIPS as a private company with activity in Semiconductor Intellectual Property (Semiconductor IP), RISC-V, and Central Processing Units (CPUs). Its recorded technical focus is RISC-V processors, embedded compute, and automotive compute, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
mips.relevanceZh: 美普思科技之所以属于目标组织全集，在于 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“RISC-V CPU 的重点与当前架构和 RTL 产品线高度匹配。”
mips.relevanceEn: MIPS belongs in the target universe where RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “RISC-V CPU focus closely matches current architecture and RTL portfolio.”

akeana.descriptionZh: Akeana 是私营企业，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括半导体知识产权（IP）、RISC-V 开放指令集架构、中央处理器（CPU）。已列出的技术重点包括 RISC-V CPU IP、数据中心处理器和定制核心；本档案以所引来源为依据。
akeana.descriptionEn: Akeana is a private company whose recorded scope includes Semiconductor Intellectual Property (Semiconductor IP), RISC-V, and Central Processing Units (CPUs). Its listed technical focus includes RISC-V CPU IP, data-center processors, and custom cores; the profile is supported by the cited source.
akeana.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，Akeana 最直接的能力对应方向是 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“新兴的 RISC-V 知识产权公司，直接契合架构和验证兴趣。”
akeana.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at Akeana, the most direct capability matches are RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. The recorded rationale states: “Emerging RISC-V IP company with direct fit to architecture and verification interests.”

ventana-micro-systems.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，Ventana Micro Systems 被归类为私营企业，公开方向覆盖 RISC-V 开放指令集架构、中央处理器（CPU）、芯粒。组织资料重点提到数据中心 RISC-V、芯片组 CPU 和处理器 IP，证据基础来自所引来源。
ventana-micro-systems.descriptionEn: In this atlas, Ventana Micro Systems is classified as a private company working across RISC-V, Central Processing Units (CPUs), and Chiplets. The organization record emphasizes data-center RISC-V, chiplet CPU, and processor IP, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.

ventana-micro-systems.relevanceEn: Ventana Micro Systems is most relevant to this search through RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “High-performance RISC-V and memory-system work align strongly with architecture, RTL and performance-modeling experience.”

rivos.descriptionZh: 这份档案把 Rivos 定位为活跃于 RISC-V 开放指令集架构、人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）、中央处理器（CPU）的私营企业。组织级证据突出 RISC-V 计算、人工智能加速与硬件-软件协同设计；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
rivos.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Rivos as a private company in RISC-V, AI Hardware, and Central Processing Units (CPUs). Organization-level evidence highlights RISC-V compute, AI acceleration, and hardware-software co-design; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
rivos.relevanceZh: 规划 Rivos 的投递或科研路径时，应从 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“架构最强，AI 硬件匹配，但团队规模小且高度挑剔。”
rivos.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Rivos should start with RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. It is included because the record says: “One of the strongest architecture plus AI hardware matches, but with a small and highly selective team.”

nvidia.descriptionZh: 组织树将英伟达归类为覆盖图形处理器（GPU）、人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）、半导体、系统的上市公司。其记录中的技术重点是 GPU、人工智能加速器、网络、自主系统和 EDA 基础设施，本简介以所引来源为依据。

nvidia.relevanceZh: 英伟达之所以属于目标组织全集，在于 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、RTL 设计、设计验证与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“顶尖目标涵盖架构、RTL、DV、EDA 自动化、AI 系统和性能。”
nvidia.relevanceEn: NVIDIA belongs in the target universe where EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, RTL Design, and Design Verification intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Top target spanning architecture, RTL/DV, EDA automation, AI systems and performance.”

amd.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，超威半导体被归类为上市公司，公开方向覆盖中央处理器（CPU）、图形处理器（GPU）、现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）、人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）。组织资料重点提到 CPU、GPU、自适应计算、人工智能加速器和 EDA 方法，证据基础来自所引来源。
amd.descriptionEn: In this atlas, AMD is classified as a public company working across Central Processing Units (CPUs), Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and AI Hardware. amd.relevanceZh: 超威半导体与本次求职最相关的能力路径是 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、设计验证、UVM。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“跨 RISC-V 邻近架构、FPGA、RTL、DV、物理设计和 AI 计算实现直接匹配。”
amd.relevanceEn: AMD is most relevant to this search through EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, Design Verification, and UVM. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Direct match across RISC-V-adjacent architecture, FPGA, RTL/DV, physical design and AI compute.”

intel.descriptionZh: 英特尔作为上市公司收录于组织树，核心范围集中在中央处理器（CPU）、半导体、半导体晶圆代工、人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）。其已记录的关注点包括 CPU、代工厂、人工智能加速器、工艺技术和 EDA；本简介以所引来源为依据。

qualcomm.descriptionZh: 高通作为上市公司收录于组织树，核心范围集中在半导体、无线技术、人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）、汽车技术。其已记录的关注点包括移动 SoC、无线、边缘 AI、汽车和 CPU；本简介以所引来源为依据。

qualcomm.relevanceEn: When screening Qualcomm, use RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Strong fit for DSP, SoC, RTL/DV and architecture; the completed Alphawave Semi acquisition adds SerDes, chiplet and data-center connectivity teams under the Qualcomm hiring path.”

broadcom.descriptionZh: 现有资料将博通置于上市公司序列，相关活动涉及半导体、网络技术、连接技术、数据存储。更具体的组织记录指向网络硅片、SerDes、存储和无线连接，并由所引来源支持。
broadcom.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies Broadcom as a public company active in Semiconductors, Networking, Connectivity, and Data Storage. More specifically, it points to networking silicon, SerDes, storage, and wireless connectivity, supported by the cited source.
broadcom.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与博通之间最强的连接位于 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“拥有庞大的硅片产品组合，涵盖多种 RTL、PD、验证和高速工作岗位。”
broadcom.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to Broadcom runs through RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “Large silicon portfolio with many RTL, PD, verification and high-speed roles.”

marvell.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Marvell Technology should start with RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. It is included because the record says: “Broad custom-silicon and interconnect portfolio now also includes the acquired Celestial AI photonic fabric and XConn PCIe/CXL switching teams.”

ibm.descriptionZh: 国际商业机器公司是上市公司，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括系统、半导体研究、人工智能（AI）、量子技术。已列出的技术重点包括处理器设计、人工智能系统、半导体研究与量子计算；本档案以所引来源为依据。

The recorded rationale states: “Offers architecture, EDA/research and quantum-adjacent routes beyond generic software.”

The recorded rationale states: “World-class semiconductor research with US programs, but role and export eligibility need verification.”

natcast.relevanceEn: Natcast belongs in the target universe where Design for Test and Production Test intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Central CHIPS R&D ecosystem organization; direct student opportunities remain to be verified.”

lawrence-berkeley-national-laboratory.descriptionZh: 劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室作为国家实验室收录于组织树，核心范围集中在研究、高性能计算（HPC）、微电子、人工智能（AI）。其已记录的关注点包括计算科学、材料、微电子学和人工智能科学；本简介以所引来源为依据。

The existing record gives this rationale: “Fundamental-research roles may be possible, but program and site-access eligibility vary.”

argonne-national-laboratory.descriptionZh: 阿贡国家实验室是国家实验室，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括研究、高性能计算（HPC）、人工智能（AI）、材料。已列出的技术重点包括高性能计算、人工智能加速器、材料和量子；本档案以所引来源为依据。

argonne-national-laboratory.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，阿贡国家实验室最直接的能力对应方向是计算机体系结构、性能分析、存储系统、可测试性设计。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“高性能计算和人工智能测试平台相关，但 DOE 的旗舰学生项目通常存在公民身份限制。”

The recorded rationale states: “HPC and AI testbeds are relevant, but flagship DOE student programs often have citizenship constraints.”

nasa-jpl.descriptionZh: 美国国家航空航天局喷气推进实验室是联邦资助研发中心，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括航天技术、机器人技术、研究、嵌入式系统。已列出的技术重点包括航天器、机器人学、嵌入式系统与自主性；本档案以所引来源为依据。

nasa-jpl.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，美国国家航空航天局喷气推进实验室最直接的能力对应方向是嵌入式系统、固件。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“技术上是本地且相关的，但 NASA 的实习项目要求美国公民身份，美国国家航空航天局喷气推进实验室机会需要严格的资格审查。”

The recorded rationale states: “Technically local and relevant, but NASA internship programs require US citizenship and JPL opportunities need exact eligibility review.”

Its documented areas of attention include superconducting quantum processors, control systems, and fabrication; the profile is grounded in the cited source.

The existing record gives this rationale: “FPGA/control and chip-fabrication roles are adjacent, but quantum export rules require review.”

ionq.relevanceEn: IonQ belongs in the target universe where FPGA Engineering, Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, and Memory Systems intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Control-electronics and FPGA roles are adjacent; job-level export restrictions must be checked.”

The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Semiconductor/photonics quantum company with relevant electronics, but high specialization and export review.”

The organization record emphasizes photoresist, coatings, temporary bonding, and advanced packaging materials, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
brewer-science.relevanceZh: Brewer Science 与本次求职最相关的能力路径是 CAD 工程、设计流程工程、可测试性设计、量产测试。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“通过亲身参与工艺开发，填补材料和封装工艺的空白。”
brewer-science.relevanceEn: Brewer Science is most relevant to this search through CAD Engineering, Design Flow Engineering, Design for Test, and Production Test. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Fills a materials and packaging-process gap with hands-on process-development roles.”

jsr-micro.descriptionZh: JSR 微电子作为私营企业子公司收录于组织树，核心范围集中在半导体材料、制造。其已记录的关注点包括光刻胶、光刻材料和先进半导体材料；本简介以所引来源为依据。
jsr-micro.descriptionEn: JSR Micro is cataloged as a private-company subsidiary centered on Semiconductor Materials and Manufacturing. Its documented areas of attention include photoresists, lithography materials, and advanced semiconductor materials; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
jsr-micro.relevanceZh: 筛选 JSR 微电子时，可先用 CAD 工程、设计流程工程、可测试性设计、量产测试作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“直接的美国材料供应商路线与光刻和晶圆客户资格相关。”
jsr-micro.relevanceEn: When screening JSR Micro, use CAD Engineering, Design Flow Engineering, Design for Test, and Production Test as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Direct US materials supplier route tied to lithography and fab customer qualification.”

Its listed technical focus includes photolithography materials, thermal interface materials, and semiconductor process materials; the profile is supported by the cited source.
shin-etsu-microsi.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，信越 MicroSi 最直接的能力对应方向是 CAD 工程、设计流程工程、可测试性设计、量产测试。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“在亚利桑那半导体集群中新增了一个重要的材料生态系统节点。”
shin-etsu-microsi.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at Shin-Etsu MicroSi, the most direct capability matches are CAD Engineering, Design Flow Engineering, Design for Test, and Production Test. The recorded rationale states: “Adds a major materials ecosystem node in the Arizona semiconductor cluster.”

sumco-phoenix.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，胜高凤凰被归类为上市公司子公司，公开方向覆盖半导体材料、硅晶圆、制造。组织资料重点提到硅晶圆、晶体生长与晶圆制造，证据基础来自所引来源。

The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Covers the upstream silicon-wafer process and Arizona manufacturing labor market.”

hemlock-semiconductor.descriptionZh: 赫姆洛克半导体是私营企业，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括半导体材料、多晶硅、制造。已列出的技术重点包括超纯多晶硅、材料制造与工艺控制；本档案以所引来源为依据。
hemlock-semiconductor.descriptionEn: Hemlock Semiconductor is a private company whose recorded scope includes Semiconductor Materials, Polysilicon, and Manufacturing. Its listed technical focus includes hyper-pure polysilicon, materials manufacturing, and process control; the profile is supported by the cited source.

The recorded rationale states: “Adds the earliest material stage of the silicon supply chain and process-control careers.”

ultra-clean-holdings.descriptionZh: 现有资料将超科林半导体置于上市公司序列，相关活动涉及半导体设备、制造、设备子系统。更具体的组织记录指向气体输送、工艺模块、精密子系统及设备服务，并由所引来源支持。

More specifically, it points to gas delivery, process modules, precision subsystems, and equipment services, supported by the cited source.
ultra-clean-holdings.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与超科林半导体之间最强的连接位于半导体制造、设备自动化。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“填充元件供应商与主要晶圆制造设备 OEM 之间的设备子系统层。”

suss-microtec-us.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，苏斯微技术美国被归类为上市公司子公司，公开方向覆盖半导体设备、先进封装、光刻。组织资料重点提到掩膜对准器、晶圆粘结、涂层、成像和先进封装，证据基础来自所引来源。

suss-microtec-us.relevanceEn: SUSS MicroTec US is most relevant to this search through CAD Engineering, Design Flow Engineering, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Adds specialty lithography and wafer-bonding equipment central to MEMS and advanced packaging.”

ebara-technologies.descriptionZh: 荏原科技作为上市公司子公司收录于组织树，核心范围集中在半导体设备、真空技术、制造。其已记录的关注点包括干式真空泵、CMP 系统及设备服务；本简介以所引来源为依据。

yield-engineering-systems.descriptionZh: 现有资料将屹世半导体置于私营企业序列，相关活动涉及半导体设备、先进封装、材料。更具体的组织记录指向热处理、表面改性及晶圆级封装设备，并由所引来源支持。

samtec.descriptionZh: 申泰是私营企业，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括连接技术、系统硬件、制造。已列出的技术重点包括高速互联、硅间链路和信号完整性；本档案以所引来源为依据。

The recorded rationale states: “Adds a high-speed interconnect path tightly coupled to chiplets, boards and test systems.”

stanford-systemx-alliance.descriptionZh: 现有资料将斯坦福大学 SystemX 联盟置于高校研究院序列，相关活动涉及半导体研究、系统硬件、高校联盟。更具体的组织记录指向集成电路、计算机结构、光子学和硬件系统，并由所引来源支持。

berkeley-bwrc.relevanceEn: Berkeley Wireless Research Center is most relevant to this search through Design for Test, Production Test, Analog Design, and Custom IC Design. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Adds a flagship circuit-and-systems research pathway with strong semiconductor industry ties.”

The existing record gives this rationale: “Geographically close research target focused on chiplets and packaging, two underrepresented portfolio areas.”

asu-macrotechnology-works.relevanceEn: When screening Arizona State University MacroTechnology Works, use FPGA Engineering, Physical Design, Static Timing Analysis, and Design for Test as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Adds a hands-on prototyping facility embedded in the fast-growing Arizona semiconductor cluster.”

nc-state-freedm-systems-center.descriptionZh: 北卡罗来纳州立大学 FREEDM 系统中心作为高校研究院收录于组织树，核心范围集中在半导体研究、电源与电力技术、系统硬件。其已记录的关注点包括宽禁隙电力电子、固态变压器和电力系统；本简介以所引来源为依据。
nc-state-freedm-systems-center.descriptionEn: NC State FREEDM Systems Center is cataloged as a university research institute centered on Semiconductor Research, Power Technology, and Systems Hardware. Its documented areas of attention include wide-bandgap power electronics, solid-state transformers, and power systems; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
nc-state-freedm-systems-center.relevanceZh: 筛选北卡罗来纳州立大学 FREEDM 系统中心时，可先用计算机体系结构、性能分析、存储系统、物理设计作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“创建了超越数字集成电路角色的功率半导体和控制路径。”
nc-state-freedm-systems-center.relevanceEn: When screening NC State FREEDM Systems Center, use Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, Memory Systems, and Physical Design as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Creates a power-semiconductor and controls pathway beyond digital IC roles.”

cornami.descriptionZh: 这份档案把 Cornami 定位为活跃于人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）、新型计算、半导体的私营企业。组织级证据突出可重构计算结构、后量子密码加速和可扩展人工智能计算；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
cornami.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Cornami as a private company in AI Hardware, Novel Computing, and Semiconductors. Organization-level evidence highlights reconfigurable computing fabric, post-quantum cryptography acceleration, and scalable AI compute; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
cornami.relevanceZh: 规划 Cornami 的投递或科研路径时，应从 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“增加了跨硅片、编译器和加密工作负载的差异化可重构架构目标。”
cornami.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Cornami should start with RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. It is included because the record says: “Adds a differentiated reconfigurable architecture target spanning silicon, compilers and cryptographic workloads.”

edgeq.descriptionZh: EdgeQ 是私营企业，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括 RISC-V 开放指令集架构、无线技术、边缘人工智能（边缘 AI）。已列出的技术重点包括 5G 基站芯片、RISC-V 计算和软件定义无线电；本档案以所引来源为依据。
edgeq.descriptionEn: EdgeQ is a private company whose recorded scope includes RISC-V, Wireless Technology, and Edge AI. Its listed technical focus includes 5G base-station-on-a-chip, RISC-V compute, and software-defined radio; the profile is supported by the cited source.
edgeq.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，EdgeQ 最直接的能力对应方向是 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“将 RISC-V、5G 信号处理和边缘计算连接在单一 SoC 平台上。”
edgeq.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at EdgeQ, the most direct capability matches are RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. The recorded rationale states: “Connects RISC-V, 5G signal processing and edge compute in a single SoC platform.”

esperanto-technologies.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，Esperanto Technologies 被归类为私营企业，公开方向覆盖 RISC-V 开放指令集架构、人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）、众核计算。组织资料重点提到节能的 RISC-V 多核、人工智能推理加速器、编译器和运行时，证据基础来自所引来源。
esperanto-technologies.descriptionEn: In this atlas, Esperanto Technologies is classified as a private company working across RISC-V, AI Hardware, and Many-Core Computing. The organization record emphasizes energy-efficient RISC-V manycore, AI inference accelerators, compiler, and runtime, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
esperanto-technologies.relevanceZh: Esperanto Technologies 与本次求职最相关的能力路径是 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“提供从微架构到运行时软件的多核 RISC-V 加速器路径。”
esperanto-technologies.relevanceEn: Esperanto Technologies is most relevant to this search through RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Provides a manycore RISC-V accelerator route from microarchitecture through runtime software.”

lightelligence.descriptionZh: Lightelligence 作为私营企业收录于组织树，核心范围集中在人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）、光子学、光计算。其已记录的关注点包括光子计算、光学互连和人工智能加速器系统；本简介以所引来源为依据。
lightelligence.descriptionEn: Lightelligence is cataloged as a private company centered on AI Hardware, Photonics, and Optical Computing. Its documented areas of attention include photonic computing, optical interconnect, and AI accelerator systems; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
lightelligence.relevanceZh: 筛选 Lightelligence 时，可先用 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“新增光计算目标，涵盖光子器件、电子器件、封装和系统集成。”
lightelligence.relevanceEn: When screening Lightelligence, use RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Adds an optical-compute target spanning photonic devices, electronics, packaging and system integration.”

normal-computing.descriptionZh: 现有资料将 Normal Computing 置于私营企业序列，相关活动涉及人工智能硬件（AI 硬件）、新型计算、人工智能基础设施（AI 基础设施）。更具体的组织记录指向热力学计算、概率人工智能系统以及硬件-软件协同设计，并由所引来源支持。
normal-computing.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies Normal Computing as a private company active in AI Hardware, Novel Computing, and AI Infrastructure. More specifically, it points to thermodynamic computing, probabilistic AI systems, and hardware-software co-design, supported by the cited source.
normal-computing.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与 Normal Computing 之间最强的连接位于计算机体系结构、性能分析、存储系统、可测试性设计。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“这是一个以研究为重的概率计算目标，以及传统 GPU 之外的共同设计 AI 系统。”
normal-computing.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to Normal Computing runs through Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, Memory Systems, and Design for Test. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “A research-heavy target for probabilistic computing and co-designed AI systems outside conventional GPUs.”

mercedes-benz-rd-north-america.descriptionZh: 这份档案把梅赛德斯-奔驰北美研发中心定位为活跃于汽车技术、研究、嵌入式系统的上市公司子公司。组织级证据突出自动驾驶、车辆计算、电气化动力系统、软件和认证；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
mercedes-benz-rd-north-america.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Mercedes-Benz Research & Development North America as a public-company subsidiary in Automotive Technology, Research, and Embedded Systems. Organization-level evidence highlights automated driving, vehicle compute, electrified powertrains, software, and certification; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
mercedes-benz-rd-north-america.relevanceZh: 规划梅赛德斯-奔驰北美研发中心的投递或科研路径时，应从可测试性设计、量产测试、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“新增一个北美第一方研发实体，涵盖车辆计算、自动驾驶、动力系统和认证领域。”
mercedes-benz-rd-north-america.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Mercedes-Benz Research & Development North America should start with Design for Test, Production Test, Analog Design, and Custom IC Design. It is included because the record says: “Adds a first-party North American R&D entity covering vehicle compute, autonomy, powertrain and certification.”

sandia-national-laboratories.descriptionZh: 桑迪亚国家实验室作为国家实验室收录于组织树，核心范围集中在半导体研究、微电子、光子学、国防技术。其已记录的关注点包括 MESA 信任微电子、硅、III-V 级制造、MEMS 和辐射硬化 ASIC 技术；本简介以所引来源为依据。
sandia-national-laboratories.descriptionEn: Sandia National Laboratories is cataloged as a national laboratory centered on Semiconductor Research, Microelectronics, Photonics, and Defense Technology. Its documented areas of attention include MESA trusted microelectronics, silicon, III-V fabrication, MEMS, and radiation-hardened ASICs; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
sandia-national-laboratories.relevanceZh: 筛选桑迪亚国家实验室时，可先用 RTL 设计、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、半导体制造作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“MESA 是一个独特的完善微电子研发和低批量制造综合体，但其国家安全使命带来了强烈的公民身份和许可限制。”
sandia-national-laboratories.relevanceEn: When screening Sandia National Laboratories, use RTL Design, Analog Design, Custom IC Design, and Semiconductor Manufacturing as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “MESA is a uniquely complete microelectronics R&D and low-volume manufacturing complex, but its national-security mission creates strong citizenship and clearance constraints.”

lawrence-livermore-national-laboratory.descriptionZh: 这份档案把劳伦斯利弗莫尔国家实验室定位为活跃于半导体研究、微电子、光子学、国防技术的国家实验室。组织级证据突出微纳米技术、半导体器件、光子 ADC 与数模转换器中心；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
lawrence-livermore-national-laboratory.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory as a national laboratory in Semiconductor Research, Microelectronics, Photonics, and Defense Technology. Organization-level evidence highlights center for Micro-, Nanotechnology, semiconductor devices, photonic ADC, and DAC; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
lawrence-livermore-national-laboratory.relevanceZh: 规划劳伦斯利弗莫尔国家实验室的投递或科研路径时，应从模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、半导体制造、设备自动化开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“劳伦斯利弗莫尔国家实验室具备明确的半导体微、纳米技术能力，而大多数现实路径都需提前核验公民身份与安全许可要求。”
lawrence-livermore-national-laboratory.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory should start with Analog Design, Custom IC Design, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation. It is included because the record says: “LLNL has explicit semiconductor micro/nanotechnology capabilities, while most realistic pathways require early screening for citizenship and security-clearance eligibility.”

los-alamos-national-laboratory.descriptionZh: 这份档案把洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室定位为活跃于半导体研究、纳米技术、量子技术、国防技术的国家实验室。组织级证据突出集成纳米技术、量子材料、微电子与纳米集成中心；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
los-alamos-national-laboratory.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Los Alamos National Laboratory as a national laboratory in Semiconductor Research, Nanotechnology, Quantum Technology, and Defense Technology. Organization-level evidence highlights center for Integrated Nanotechnologies, quantum materials, microelectronics, and nanoscale integration; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
los-alamos-national-laboratory.relevanceZh: 规划洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的投递或科研路径时，应从可测试性设计、量产测试、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“CINT 提供真正的微电子学和纳米集成研究，但洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的就业和项目通常存在严格的资格限制。”
los-alamos-national-laboratory.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Los Alamos National Laboratory should start with Design for Test, Production Test, Analog Design, and Custom IC Design. It is included because the record says: “CINT provides real microelectronics and nanointegration research, but LANL employment and projects frequently carry hard eligibility constraints.”

oak-ridge-national-laboratory.descriptionZh: 这份档案把橡树岭国家实验室定位为活跃于半导体研究、微电子、高性能计算（HPC）、电源与电力技术的国家实验室。组织级证据突出下一代微电子学、材料、纳米制造、神经形态和光子电路；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
oak-ridge-national-laboratory.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Oak Ridge National Laboratory as a national laboratory in Semiconductor Research, Microelectronics, High-Performance Computing (HPC), and Power Technology. Organization-level evidence highlights next-generation microelectronics, materials, nanofabrication, neuromorphic, and photonic circuits; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
oak-ridge-national-laboratory.relevanceZh: 规划橡树岭国家实验室的投递或科研路径时，应从计算机体系结构、性能分析、存储系统、可测试性设计开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“橡树岭国家实验室明确涵盖材料、制造、架构、光子学和电力电子学；资格因项目和设施而异。”
oak-ridge-national-laboratory.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Oak Ridge National Laboratory should start with Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, Memory Systems, and Design for Test. It is included because the record says: “ORNL explicitly spans materials, fabrication, architecture, photonics and power electronics; eligibility varies by project and facility.”

pacific-northwest-national-laboratory.descriptionZh: 这份档案把太平洋西北国家实验室定位为活跃于半导体研究、微电子、材料、高性能计算（HPC）的国家实验室。组织级证据突出 DeCoDe 异构计算、极紫外源、材料研究、微电子路线图和精密材料；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
pacific-northwest-national-laboratory.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Pacific Northwest National Laboratory as a national laboratory in Semiconductor Research, Microelectronics, Materials, and High-Performance Computing (HPC). Organization-level evidence highlights deCoDe heterogeneous computing, EUV source, materials research, microelectronics roadmap, and precision materials; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
pacific-northwest-national-laboratory.relevanceZh: 规划太平洋西北国家实验室的投递或科研路径时，应从计算机体系结构、性能分析、存储系统、可测试性设计开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“太平洋西北国家实验室为国家微电子中心和异构共设计做出贡献，但具体项目有不同的接入规则。”
pacific-northwest-national-laboratory.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Pacific Northwest National Laboratory should start with Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, Memory Systems, and Design for Test. It is included because the record says: “PNNL contributes to national microelectronics centers and heterogeneous co-design, but specific projects have different access rules.”

national-renewable-energy-laboratory.descriptionZh: 落基山国家实验室（NLR，原 NREL）是美国能源部国家实验室，重点覆盖关键材料、能源系统、电力电子、人工智能与科学计算。能源部于 2025 年 12 月将其由美国国家可再生能源实验室更名为现名；本档案使用当前规范名称。
national-renewable-energy-laboratory.descriptionEn: The National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR, formerly NREL) is a U.S. Department of Energy national laboratory focused on critical materials, energy systems, power electronics, artificial intelligence, and scientific computing. DOE renamed the former National Renewable Energy Laboratory in December 2025; this profile uses the current canonical name.
national-renewable-energy-laboratory.relevanceZh: 筛选落基山国家实验室时，可优先关注电力电子、材料研究、科学计算、控制与研究软件岗位。其实习和研究路径可形成半导体相邻经验，但具体项目的学生身份、工作授权和实验室资格必须逐公告核验。
national-renewable-energy-laboratory.relevanceEn: When screening NLR, prioritize power electronics, materials research, scientific computing, controls, and research-software roles. Its internships and research pathways can build semiconductor-adjacent evidence, but student status, work authorization, and laboratory eligibility must be verified against each exact posting.

nist-chips-rd.descriptionZh: 这份档案把美国国家标准与技术研究院定位为活跃于半导体研究、计量、先进封装、技术标准的联邦科研机构。组织级证据突出芯片研发项目、半导体计量、先进封装、标准与纳米制造；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
nist-chips-rd.descriptionEn: This profile identifies National Institute of Standards and Technology as a federal research agency in Semiconductor Research, Metrology, Advanced Packaging, and Technical Standards. Organization-level evidence highlights CHIPS R&D programs, semiconductor metrology, advanced packaging, standards, and nanofabrication; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
nist-chips-rd.relevanceZh: 规划美国国家标准与技术研究院的投递或科研路径时，应从物理设计、静态时序分析、可测试性设计、量产测试开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“美国国家标准与技术研究院是半导体研发和计量的核心节点，但联邦就业通常要求具备严格的公民资格，且 CHIPS 资助项目并非个人实习。”
nist-chips-rd.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for National Institute of Standards and Technology should start with Physical Design, Static Timing Analysis, Design for Test, and Production Test. It is included because the record says: “NIST is a central semiconductor R&D and metrology node, but federal employment generally requires exact citizenship eligibility and CHIPS funding programs are not individual internships.”

cn-empyrean.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，华大九天被归类为企业，公开方向覆盖电子设计自动化（EDA）。组织资料重点提到模拟、数字、晶圆制造 EDA、IP、设计服务，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-empyrean.descriptionEn: In this atlas, Empyrean Technology is classified as a company working across Electronic Design Automation (EDA). The organization record emphasizes analog, digital, wafer manufacturing EDA, IP, and design services, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
cn-empyrean.relevanceZh: 华大九天与本次求职最相关的能力路径是 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、CAD 工程、设计流程工程。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“本土全流程 EDA 代表企业，适合把电路、算法与工程软件能力结合。”
cn-empyrean.relevanceEn: Empyrean Technology is most relevant to this search through EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, CAD Engineering, and Design Flow Engineering. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “A representative domestic full-flow EDA company, well suited to combining circuits, algorithms, and engineering software capabilities.”

cn-primarius.descriptionZh: 组织树将概伦电子归类为覆盖电子设计自动化（EDA）的企业。其记录中的技术重点是器件建模、电路仿真、良率、测试，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-primarius.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies Primarius Technologies as a company with activity in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). Its recorded technical focus is device modeling, circuit simulation, yield, and testing, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-primarius.relevanceZh: 概伦电子之所以属于目标组织全集，在于 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、CAD 工程、设计流程工程与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“器件建模、仿真与制造良率方向能形成稀缺的 EDA 纵深。”
cn-primarius.relevanceEn: Primarius Technologies belongs in the target universe where EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, CAD Engineering, and Design Flow Engineering intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Device modeling, simulation, and manufacturing yield can create scarce EDA depth.”

cn-semitronix.descriptionZh: 这份档案把广立微定位为活跃于电子设计自动化（EDA）、半导体测试的企业。组织级证据突出良率提升 EDA、晶圆级电性测试、数据分析；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
cn-semitronix.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Semitronix as a company in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and Semiconductor Testing. Organization-level evidence highlights yield-improvement EDA, wafer-level electrical testing, and data analysis; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
cn-semitronix.relevanceZh: 规划广立微的投递或科研路径时，应从 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、CAD 工程、设计流程工程开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“连接制造数据、测试硬件和软件算法，适合解决真实工艺问题。”
cn-semitronix.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Semitronix should start with EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, CAD Engineering, and Design Flow Engineering. It is included because the record says: “Connecting manufacturing data and testing hardware and software algorithms, suitable for solving real process problems.”

cn-xpeedic.descriptionZh: 现有资料将芯和半导体置于企业序列，相关活动涉及电子设计自动化（EDA）。更具体的组织记录指向电磁场仿真、多物理场、封装、系统 EDA，并由所引来源支持。
cn-xpeedic.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies Xpeedic as a company active in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). More specifically, it points to electromagnetic field simulation, multiphysics, packaging, and system EDA, supported by the cited source.
cn-xpeedic.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与芯和半导体之间最强的连接位于 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、CAD 工程、设计流程工程。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“面向先进封装和高速系统的仿真工具，差异化强。”

cn-xpeng.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，小鹏汽车最直接的能力对应方向是嵌入式系统、固件。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“智驾与机器人研发可将算法、嵌入式和系统工程结合。”
cn-xpeng.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at XPeng, the most direct capability matches are Embedded Systems and Firmware. The recorded rationale states: “Intelligent driving and robotics development can combine algorithms, embedded systems, and systems engineering.”

cn-li-auto.descriptionZh: 这份档案把理想汽车定位为活跃于新能源汽车、智能驾驶的企业。组织级证据突出智能驾驶、车载计算、整车软件；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
cn-li-auto.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Li Auto as a company in New Energy Vehicles and Intelligent Driving. Organization-level evidence highlights intelligent driving, in-vehicle computing, and vehicle software; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
cn-li-auto.relevanceZh: 规划理想汽车的投递或科研路径时，应从嵌入式系统、固件开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“规模化智驾与整车软件岗位重视工程落地和系统指标。”
cn-li-auto.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Li Auto should start with Embedded Systems and Firmware. It is included because the record says: “Large-scale intelligent driving and complete vehicle software positions emphasize project implementation and system indicators.”

cn-geely.descriptionZh: 吉利控股集团作为企业收录于组织树，核心范围集中在汽车、智能驾驶。其已记录的关注点包括汽车电子、智驾、车载平台；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-geely.descriptionEn: Geely is cataloged as a company centered on Automotive and Intelligent Driving. Its documented areas of attention include automotive electronics, intelligent driving, and in-vehicle platforms; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-geely.relevanceZh: 筛选吉利控股集团时，可先用嵌入式系统、固件作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“多品牌与整车平台提供车载软件和电子系统岗位。”
cn-geely.relevanceEn: When screening Geely, use Embedded Systems and Firmware as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Multi-brand and vehicle platforms provide positions in in-vehicle software and electronic systems.”

cn-saic.descriptionZh: 组织树将上汽集团归类为覆盖汽车、智能驾驶的企业。其记录中的技术重点是智能电动汽车、软件平台，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-saic.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies SAIC Motor as a company with activity in Automotive and Intelligent Driving. Its recorded technical focus is smart electric vehicles and software platforms, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-saic.relevanceZh: 上汽集团之所以属于目标组织全集，在于可测试性设计、量产测试、嵌入式系统、固件与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“大型整车与软件生态提供量产、测试和平台岗位。”
cn-saic.relevanceEn: SAIC Motor belongs in the target universe where Design for Test, Production Test, Embedded Systems, and Firmware intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Large vehicle and software ecosystems provide positions in mass production, testing, and platforms.”

cn-gac.descriptionZh: 现有资料将广汽集团置于企业序列，相关活动涉及汽车、智能驾驶。更具体的组织记录指向智能电动汽车、智驾、车载电子，并由所引来源支持。
cn-gac.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies GAC Group as a company active in Automotive and Intelligent Driving. More specifically, it points to smart electric vehicles, intelligent driving, and in-car electronics, supported by the cited source.
cn-gac.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与广汽集团之间最强的连接位于可测试性设计、量产测试、嵌入式系统、固件。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“大湾区整车和智驾体系提供软件、算法和硬件岗位。”
cn-gac.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to GAC Group runs through Design for Test, Production Test, Embedded Systems, and Firmware. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “The Greater Bay Area provides software, algorithms, and hardware positions for complete vehicles and intelligent driving systems.”

cn-gwm.descriptionZh: 长城汽车是企业，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括汽车、智能驾驶。已列出的技术重点包括智能汽车、动力、车载软件；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-gwm.descriptionEn: GWM is a company whose recorded scope includes Automotive and Intelligent Driving. Its listed technical focus includes smart cars, powertrains, and in-vehicle software; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-gwm.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，长城汽车最直接的能力对应方向是嵌入式系统、固件。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“整车、动力和智驾业务提供嵌入式与控制岗位。”
cn-gwm.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at GWM, the most direct capability matches are Embedded Systems and Firmware. The recorded rationale states: “Vehicle, powertrain, and intelligent driving businesses provide embedded and control positions.”

cn-changan.descriptionZh: 长安汽车是企业，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括汽车、智能驾驶。已列出的技术重点包括智能汽车、车载软件、动力系统；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-changan.descriptionEn: Changan Auto is a company whose recorded scope includes Automotive and Intelligent Driving. Its listed technical focus includes smart cars, in-vehicle software, and powertrains; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-changan.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，长安汽车最直接的能力对应方向是嵌入式系统、固件。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“央企整车平台在软件定义汽车和智能化方向投入大。”
cn-changan.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at Changan Auto, the most direct capability matches are Embedded Systems and Firmware. The recorded rationale states: “Central SOE vehicle platforms have made significant investments in software-defined vehicles and intelligent technologies.”

cn-dji.descriptionZh: 大疆创新是企业，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括机器人、嵌入式系统。已列出的技术重点包括无人机、视觉、控制、嵌入式系统；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-dji.descriptionEn: DJI is a company whose recorded scope includes Robotics and Embedded Systems. Its listed technical focus includes drones, vision, control, and embedded systems; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-dji.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，大疆创新最直接的能力对应方向是 FPGA 工程、嵌入式系统、固件。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“软硬件高度一体化，对控制、感知、嵌入式和工程质量要求高。”
cn-dji.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at DJI, the most direct capability matches are FPGA Engineering, Embedded Systems, and Firmware. The recorded rationale states: “Highly integrated hardware and software, with high requirements for control, sensing, embedded, and engineering quality.”

cn-unitree.descriptionZh: 这份档案把宇树科技定位为活跃于机器人、具身智能的企业。组织级证据突出四足、人形机器人；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
cn-unitree.descriptionEn: This profile identifies Unitree Robotics as a company in Robotics and Embodied AI. Organization-level evidence highlights quadruped and humanoid robot; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
cn-unitree.relevanceZh: 规划宇树科技的投递或科研路径时，应从嵌入式系统、固件开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“高动态机器人要求控制、感知、嵌入式和机电一体化。”
cn-unitree.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for Unitree Robotics should start with Embedded Systems and Firmware. It is included because the record says: “Highly dynamic robots require control, sensing, embedded, and mechatronic integration.”

cn-ubtech.descriptionZh: 优必选作为企业收录于组织树，核心范围集中在机器人、具身智能。其已记录的关注点包括人形机器人、智能制造；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-ubtech.descriptionEn: UBTECH Robotics is cataloged as a company centered on Robotics and Embodied AI. Its documented areas of attention include humanoid robots and intelligent manufacturing; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-ubtech.relevanceZh: 筛选优必选时，可先用嵌入式系统、固件、半导体制造、设备自动化作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“人形机器人量产和工业场景需要跨学科工程能力。”
cn-ubtech.relevanceEn: When screening UBTECH Robotics, use Embedded Systems, Firmware, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Mass production of humanoid robots and industrial scenarios require interdisciplinary engineering capabilities.”

cn-agibot.descriptionZh: 这份档案把智元机器人定位为活跃于机器人、具身智能的企业。组织级证据突出人形机器人、机器人硬件、具身模型；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
cn-agibot.descriptionEn: This profile identifies AgiBot as a company in Robotics and Embodied AI. Organization-level evidence highlights humanoid robots, robot hardware, and embodied models; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
cn-agibot.relevanceZh: 规划智元机器人的投递或科研路径时，应从嵌入式系统、固件开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“具身智能从机器人硬件到具身模型的全栈岗位密集。”
cn-agibot.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for AgiBot should start with Embedded Systems and Firmware. It is included because its roles can span the full hardware-to-embodied-model stack.

cn-fourier.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，傅利叶智能被归类为企业，公开方向覆盖机器人、医疗机器人。组织资料重点提到康复机器人、人形机器人，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-fourier.descriptionEn: In this atlas, Fourier Intelligence is classified as a company working across Robotics and Medical Robotics. The organization record emphasizes rehabilitation robots and humanoid robots, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
cn-fourier.relevanceZh: 傅利叶智能与本次求职最相关的能力路径是嵌入式系统、固件。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“医疗与人形机器人兼顾控制、安全、嵌入式和人机交互。”
cn-fourier.relevanceEn: Fourier Intelligence is most relevant to this search through Embedded Systems and Firmware. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Medical and humanoid robots balance control, safety, embeddedness, and human-machine interaction.”

cn-cas-ime.descriptionZh: 组织树将中国科学院微电子研究所归类为覆盖中科院研究所、集成电路的研究院。其记录中的技术重点是微电子器件、工艺、EDA、集成系统，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-cas-ime.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies IME CAS as a research institute with activity in Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes and Integrated Circuits. Its recorded technical focus is microelectronic devices, processes, EDA, and integrated systems, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-cas-ime.relevanceZh: 中国科学院微电子研究所之所以属于目标组织全集，在于 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“覆盖微电子全链条的国家科研机构，适合科研与联合培养路径。”
cn-cas-ime.relevanceEn: IME CAS belongs in the target universe where EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, Analog Design, and Custom IC Design intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “A national research institution covering the entire microelectronics chain, suitable for research and joint training paths.”

cn-cas-ict.descriptionZh: 组织树将中国科学院计算技术研究所归类为覆盖中科院研究所、计算体系结构的研究院。其记录中的技术重点是处理器、体系结构、系统、AI，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-cas-ict.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies ICT CAS as a research institute with activity in Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes and Computer Architecture. Its recorded technical focus is processors, architectures, systems, and AI, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-cas-ict.relevanceZh: 中国科学院计算技术研究所之所以属于目标组织全集，在于计算机体系结构、性能分析、存储系统、嵌入式系统与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“计算体系结构与处理器研究核心机构，香山等项目可公开参与。”
cn-cas-ict.relevanceEn: ICT CAS belongs in the target universe where Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, Memory Systems, and Embedded Systems intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “A core research institution for computing architecture and processors; projects such as Xiangshan are open to public participation.”

cn-cas-semi.descriptionZh: 中国科学院半导体研究所作为研究院收录于组织树，核心范围集中在中科院研究所、半导体器件。其已记录的关注点包括半导体材料、器件、光电子、集成；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-cas-semi.descriptionEn: IOS CAS is cataloged as a research institute centered on Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes and Semiconductor Devices. Its documented areas of attention include semiconductor materials, devices, optoelectronics, and integration; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-cas-semi.relevanceZh: 筛选中国科学院半导体研究所时，可先用模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、半导体制造、设备自动化作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“半导体材料与光电子研究纵深强。”
cn-cas-semi.relevanceEn: When screening IOS CAS, use Analog Design, Custom IC Design, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Strong depth of research in semiconductor materials and optoelectronics.”

cn-cas-simit.descriptionZh: 现有资料将中国科学院上海微系统与信息技术研究所置于研究院序列，相关活动涉及中科院研究所、微系统。更具体的组织记录指向集成电路材料、传感器、微系统，并由所引来源支持。
cn-cas-simit.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies SIMIT CAS as a research institute active in Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes and Microsystems. More specifically, it points to integrated circuit materials, sensors, and microsystems, supported by the cited source.
cn-cas-simit.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与中国科学院上海微系统与信息技术研究所之间最强的连接位于模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、半导体制造、设备自动化。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“SOI、MEMS 和集成材料方向平台强。”
cn-cas-simit.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to SIMIT CAS runs through Analog Design, Custom IC Design, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “Strong platforms in SOI, MEMS, and integrated materials.”

cn-cas-ia.descriptionZh: 这份档案把中国科学院自动化研究所定位为活跃于中科院研究所、人工智能的研究院。组织级证据突出模式识别、机器学习、智能系统；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
cn-cas-ia.descriptionEn: This profile identifies CASIA as a research institute in Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes and Artificial Intelligence. Organization-level evidence highlights pattern recognition, machine learning, and intelligent systems; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
cn-cas-ia.relevanceZh: 规划中国科学院自动化研究所的投递或科研路径时，应从嵌入式系统、固件开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“AI 与智能系统研究强，适合算法科研和具身方向。”
cn-cas-ia.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for CASIA should start with Embedded Systems and Firmware. It is included because the record says: “Strong research in AI and intelligent systems, suitable for algorithm research and embodied fields.”

cn-cas-siat.descriptionZh: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院作为研究院收录于组织树，核心范围集中在中科院研究所、人工智能、机器人。其已记录的关注点包括机器人、医疗、AI、集成技术；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-cas-siat.descriptionEn: SIAT is cataloged as a research institute centered on Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes, Artificial Intelligence, and Robotics. Its documented areas of attention include robotics, medical, AI, and integrated technologies; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-cas-siat.relevanceZh: 筛选中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院时，可先用嵌入式系统、固件作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“应用科研与产业合作密集，入口较多但需课题组核验。”
cn-cas-siat.relevanceEn: When screening SIAT, use Embedded Systems and Firmware as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Applied research and industry cooperation are dense, with many entry points but require verification by the research team.”

cn-caict.descriptionZh: 中国信息通信研究院是研究院，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括央国企研究院、标准与产业研究。已列出的技术重点包括 ICT 测试、标准、云网、AI 治理；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-caict.descriptionEn: CAICT is a research institute whose recorded scope includes State-Owned Enterprise Research Institutes and Standards and Industry Research. Its listed technical focus includes ICT testing, standards, cloud-network, and AI governance; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-caict.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，中国信息通信研究院最直接的能力对应方向是可测试性设计、量产测试。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“标准、测试和产业研究适合从技术延伸到平台与政策。”
cn-caict.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at CAICT, the most direct capability matches are Design for Test and Production Test. The recorded rationale states: “Standards, testing, and industry research are suitable for extending from technology to platforms and policies.”

cn-cesi.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，中国电子技术标准化研究院被归类为研究院，公开方向覆盖央国企研究院、标准与测试。组织资料重点提到电子信息标准、检测、认证，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-cesi.descriptionEn: In this atlas, CESI is classified as a research institute working across State-Owned Enterprise Research Institutes and Standards and Testing. The organization record emphasizes standards, testing, and certification for electronic information, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
cn-cesi.relevanceZh: 中国电子技术标准化研究院与本次求职最相关的能力路径是可测试性设计、量产测试。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“提供集成电路和电子信息领域独特的标准研究与检测路径。”
cn-cesi.relevanceEn: CESI is most relevant to this search through Design for Test and Production Test. It offers a distinctive path into standards research and testing for integrated circuits and electronic-information technologies.

cn-cetc-13.descriptionZh: 这份档案把中国电科十三所定位为活跃于央国企研究院、半导体器件的研究院。组织级证据突出半导体器件、微波、光电子；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
cn-cetc-13.descriptionEn: This profile identifies CETC 13th Institute as a research institute in State-Owned Enterprise Research Institutes and Semiconductor Devices. Organization-level evidence highlights semiconductor devices, microwaves, and optoelectronics; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
cn-cetc-13.relevanceZh: 规划中国电科十三所的投递或科研路径时，应从可测试性设计、量产测试、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“化合物半导体与微波器件研究制造平台。”
cn-cetc-13.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for CETC 13th Institute should start with Design for Test, Production Test, Analog Design, and Custom IC Design. It is included because the record says: “A research and manufacturing platform for compound semiconductors and microwave devices.”

cn-cetc-14.descriptionZh: 中国电科十四所是研究院，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括央国企研究院、雷达与电子系统。已列出的技术重点包括雷达、阵列、电子信息系统；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-cetc-14.descriptionEn: CETC 14th Institute is a research institute whose recorded scope includes State-Owned Enterprise Research Institutes and Radar and Electronic Systems. Its listed technical focus includes radar, arrays, and electronic information systems; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-cetc-14.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，中国电科十四所最直接的能力对应方向是模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、嵌入式系统、固件。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“阵列、射频与实时系统技术密度高，但资格限制显著。”
cn-cetc-14.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at CETC 14th Institute, the most direct capability matches are Analog Design, Custom IC Design, Embedded Systems, and Firmware. cn-nanjing-thirdgen-center.relevanceZh: 规划国家第三代半导体技术创新中心（南京）的投递或科研路径时，应从可测试性设计、量产测试、半导体制造、设备自动化开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“第三代半导体从材料到器件与平台验证的国家级载体。”
cn-nanjing-thirdgen-center.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for National Third-Generation Semiconductor Technology Innovation Center (Nanjing) should start with Design for Test, Production Test, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation. It is included because the record says: “Third-generation semiconductors serve as a national-level carrier for verification from materials to devices and platforms.”

cn-icrd.descriptionZh: 上海集成电路研发中心是创新平台，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括地方创新平台、公共研发。已列出的技术重点包括工艺研发、公共平台、产学研合作；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-icrd.descriptionEn: ICRD is an innovation platform whose recorded scope includes Regional Innovation Platforms and Public R&D. Its listed technical focus includes process research and development, public platforms, and industry-university-research cooperation; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-icrd.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，上海集成电路研发中心最直接的能力对应方向是 CAD 工程、设计流程工程、半导体制造、设备自动化。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“面向行业开放的研发平台，连接高校与晶圆制造企业。”
cn-icrd.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at ICRD, the most direct capability matches are CAD Engineering, Design Flow Engineering, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation. The recorded rationale states: “An industry-oriented R&D platform connecting universities and wafer manufacturing companies.”

cn-gba-ic-institute.descriptionZh: 广东省大湾区集成电路与系统应用研究院是创新平台，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括地方创新平台、集成电路。已列出的技术重点包括 FDSOI、光电异质集成、计算光刻、汽车芯片；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-gba-ic-institute.descriptionEn: GBA IC Institute is an innovation platform whose recorded scope includes Regional Innovation Platforms and Integrated Circuits. Its listed technical focus includes FDSOI, optoelectronic heterogeneous integration, computational lithography, and automotive chips; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-gba-ic-institute.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，广东省大湾区集成电路与系统应用研究院最直接的能力对应方向是 EDA 研发、EDA 算法、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“方向覆盖 FDSOI、计算光刻、光电和汽车芯片，适合交叉研发。”
cn-gba-ic-institute.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at GBA IC Institute, the most direct capability matches are EDA Research, EDA Algorithms, Analog Design, and Custom IC Design. The recorded rationale states: “The focus covers FDSOI, computational lithography, optoelectronics, and automotive chips, making it suitable for cross-disciplinary R&D.”

cn-openatom.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，开放原子开源基金会被归类为开源生态，公开方向覆盖开源生态、产业组织。组织资料重点提到开源项目治理、社区、产业协作，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-openatom.descriptionEn: In this atlas, OpenAtom Foundation is classified as an open-source ecosystem working across Open-Source Ecosystem and Industry Associations. The organization record emphasizes open source project governance, community, and industry collaboration, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
cn-openatom.relevanceZh: 开放原子开源基金会与本次求职最相关的能力路径是 CAD 工程、设计流程工程。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“可通过开源项目贡献形成公开、可验证的工程信号。”
cn-openatom.relevanceEn: OpenAtom Foundation is most relevant to this search through CAD Engineering and Design Flow Engineering. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Open source project contributions can be used to form public, verifiable engineering signals.”

cn-beijing-open-source-chip.descriptionZh: 现有资料将北京开源芯片研究院置于开源生态序列，相关活动涉及开源芯片、RISC-V 开放指令集架构。更具体的组织记录指向香山高性能 RISC-V 处理器、开源芯片生态，并由所引来源支持。
cn-beijing-open-source-chip.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies BOSC as an open-source ecosystem active in Open-Source Chips and RISC-V. More specifically, it points to the XiangShan high-performance RISC-V processor and the open-source chip ecosystem, supported by the cited source.
cn-beijing-open-source-chip.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与北京开源芯片研究院之间最强的连接位于 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“香山提供少有的高性能 CPU 公开贡献与科研工程路径。”
cn-beijing-open-source-chip.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to BOSC runs through RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “XiangShan offers a rare path for public contributions to a high-performance CPU project and for research engineering.”

cn-openharmony.descriptionZh: OpenHarmony 项目群是开源生态，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括开源生态、操作系统。已列出的技术重点包括分布式操作系统、设备生态；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-openharmony.descriptionEn: OpenHarmony is an open-source ecosystem whose recorded scope includes Open-Source Ecosystem and Operating Systems. Its listed technical focus includes distributed operating systems and device ecosystem; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-openharmony.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，OpenHarmony 项目群最直接的能力对应方向是嵌入式系统、固件、半导体制造、设备自动化。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“可用公开代码贡献证明 OS、驱动和嵌入式工程能力。”
cn-openharmony.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at OpenHarmony, the most direct capability matches are Embedded Systems, Firmware, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation. The recorded rationale states: “Public code contributions can demonstrate OS, driver, and embedded engineering capabilities.”

cn-csia.descriptionZh: 现有资料将中国半导体行业协会置于行业组织序列，相关活动涉及产业组织、半导体生态。更具体的组织记录指向行业服务、标准、培训、产业交流，并由所引来源支持。
cn-csia.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies CSIA as an industry organization active in Industry Associations and Semiconductor Ecosystem. More specifically, it points to industry services, standards, training, and industry exchange, supported by the cited source.
cn-csia.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与中国半导体行业协会之间最强的连接位于半导体制造、设备自动化。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“会员名录与分会可作为产业宇宙发现和证据交叉核验入口。”
cn-csia.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to CSIA runs through Semiconductor Manufacturing and Equipment Automation. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “The membership directory and chapters serve as entry points for industry universe discovery and evidence cross-verification.”

cn-riscv-industry-alliance.descriptionZh: 中国 RISC-V 产业联盟作为行业组织收录于组织树，核心范围集中在产业组织、RISC-V 开放指令集架构。其已记录的关注点包括 RISC-V 产业协作、生态；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-riscv-industry-alliance.descriptionEn: CRVIC is cataloged as an industry organization centered on Industry Associations and RISC-V. Its documented areas of attention include RISC-V industry collaboration and ecosystem; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-riscv-industry-alliance.relevanceZh: 筛选中国 RISC-V 产业联盟时，可先用计算机体系结构、性能分析、存储系统作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“可追踪 RISC-V 成员企业、活动和技术生态；实际岗位机会须回到对应成员单位核验。”
cn-riscv-industry-alliance.relevanceEn: When screening CRVIC, use Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, and Memory Systems as the first capability screen. The alliance is useful for tracking RISC-V member companies, events, and the technical ecosystem, while actual job opportunities must be verified with the relevant member organization.

cn-uestc-icie.descriptionZh: 这份档案把电子科技大学国家集成电路产教融合创新平台定位为活跃于产教融合平台、集成电路的创新平台。组织级证据突出设计与工艺贯通实践、人才培养；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。
cn-uestc-icie.descriptionEn: This profile identifies UESTC ICIE as an innovation platform in Industry–Education Integration Platforms and Integrated Circuits. Organization-level evidence highlights integrated design-and-process practice and talent development; those directions should not be mistaken for a current opening.
cn-uestc-icie.relevanceZh: 规划电子科技大学国家集成电路产教融合创新平台的投递或科研路径时，应从 CAD 工程、设计流程工程、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计开始。将其纳入图谱，是因为记录说明：“强调设计与工艺技术贯通，可补足仅有课堂知识的工程缺口。”
cn-uestc-icie.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for UESTC ICIE should start with CAD Engineering, Design Flow Engineering, Analog Design, and Custom IC Design. Its integrated practice across design and process technology can close engineering gaps left by classroom-only learning.

cn-montage-technology.descriptionZh: 澜起科技作为企业收录于组织树，核心范围集中在存储、通信芯片、AI 基础设施。其已记录的关注点包括 DDR 内存接口芯片、PCIe Retimer、CXL 内存扩展控制器、服务器平台；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-montage-technology.descriptionEn: Montage Technology is cataloged as a company centered on Memory, Communications Chips, and AI Infrastructure. Its documented areas of attention include DDR memory interface chips, PCIe Retimer, CXL memory expansion controllers, and server platforms; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-montage-technology.relevanceZh: 筛选澜起科技时，可先用 CAD 工程、设计流程工程、RTL 设计、设计验证作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“补齐内存接口、CXL 和数据中心互连这一关键架构与验证方向。”
cn-montage-technology.relevanceEn: When screening Montage Technology, use CAD Engineering, Design Flow Engineering, RTL Design, and Design Verification as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Addressing key architectural and verification directions such as memory interfaces, CXL, and data center interconnects.”

cn-asr-microelectronics.descriptionZh: 组织树将翱捷科技归类为覆盖通信芯片、移动 SoC、无线连接的企业。其记录中的技术重点是蜂窝基带、智能手机 SoC、IoT 连接芯片，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-asr-microelectronics.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies ASR Microelectronics as a company with activity in Communications Chips, Mobile SoCs, and Wireless Connectivity. Its recorded technical focus is cellular baseband, smartphone SoC, and IoT connectivity chips, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-asr-microelectronics.relevanceZh: 翱捷科技之所以属于目标组织全集，在于 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“提供从基带算法、SoC 到协议栈和射频的完整通信芯片路径。”
cn-asr-microelectronics.relevanceEn: ASR Microelectronics belongs in the target universe where RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Provides a complete communication chip path from baseband algorithms and SoCs to protocol stacks and RF.”

cn-ingenic.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，北京君正被归类为企业，公开方向覆盖中央处理器（CPU）、微控制器（MCU）、存储、边缘计算。组织资料重点提到 MIPS、XBurst 处理器、智能视频 SoC、存储芯片，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-ingenic.descriptionEn: In this atlas, Ingenic Semiconductor is classified as a company working across Central Processing Units (CPUs), Microcontroller Units (MCUs), Memory, and Edge Computing. The organization record emphasizes MIPS, XBurst processors, intelligent video SoCs, and memory chips, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
cn-ingenic.relevanceZh: 北京君正与本次求职最相关的能力路径是 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“横跨处理器、嵌入式视觉和存储，可形成软硬协同求职路线。”
cn-ingenic.relevanceEn: Ingenic Semiconductor is most relevant to this search through RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Across processors, embedded vision, and storage, a collaborative software-hardware job search route can be formed.”

cn-goke-microelectronics.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，国科微被归类为企业，公开方向覆盖 AI 芯片、存储、视频芯片。组织资料重点提到智能视觉、固态存储控制器、卫星导航、视频解码，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-goke-microelectronics.descriptionEn: In this atlas, Goke Microelectronics is classified as a company working across AI Chips, Memory, and Video Chips. The organization record emphasizes intelligent vision, solid-state storage controllers, satellite navigation, and video decoding, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
cn-goke-microelectronics.relevanceZh: 国科微与本次求职最相关的能力路径是 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“补充视频、存储控制和嵌入式 SoC 方向，岗位族跨度适中。”
cn-goke-microelectronics.relevanceEn: Goke Microelectronics is most relevant to this search through RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Supplementing video, storage control, and embedded SoC directions, with a moderate range of job families.”

cn-fullhan-microelectronics.descriptionZh: 富瀚微作为企业收录于组织树，核心范围集中在视频芯片、计算机视觉、AI 芯片。其已记录的关注点包括视频监控 SoC、ISP、边缘 AI 视觉；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-fullhan-microelectronics.descriptionEn: Fullhan Microelectronics is cataloged as a company centered on Video Chips, Computer Vision, and AI Chips. Its documented areas of attention include video surveillance SoC, ISP, and edge AI vision; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-fullhan-microelectronics.relevanceZh: 筛选富瀚微时，可先用 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“聚焦 ISP、视频 SoC 与边缘视觉，适合硬件和算法协同准备。”
cn-fullhan-microelectronics.relevanceEn: When screening Fullhan Microelectronics, use RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Focusing on ISPs, video SoCs, and edge vision, suitable for hardware and algorithm collaboration preparation.”

cn-unigroup-guoxin.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，紫光国微被归类为企业，公开方向覆盖安全芯片、现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）、集成电路。组织资料重点提到安全芯片、特种集成电路、可编程器件，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-unigroup-guoxin.descriptionEn: In this atlas, Unigroup Guoxin is classified as a company working across Security Chips, Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and Integrated Circuits. The organization record emphasizes security chips, special integrated circuits, and programmable devices, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
cn-unigroup-guoxin.relevanceZh: 紫光国微与本次求职最相关的能力路径是 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“覆盖安全与可编程逻辑，但必须先核验具体子公司、项目和身份要求。”
cn-unigroup-guoxin.relevanceEn: Unigroup Guoxin is most relevant to this search through RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Cover security and programmable logic, but must first verify specific subsidiaries, projects, and identity requirements.”

cn-shanghai-belling.descriptionZh: 现有资料将上海贝岭置于企业序列，相关活动涉及模拟芯片、电源管理芯片、集成电路。更具体的组织记录指向电源管理、智能计量、ADC、DAC、功率器件，并由所引来源支持。
cn-shanghai-belling.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies Shanghai Belling as a company active in Analog Chips, Power Management ICs, and Integrated Circuits. More specifically, it points to power management, intelligent metering, ADC, DAC, and power devices, supported by the cited source.
cn-shanghai-belling.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与上海贝岭之间最强的连接位于 CAD 工程、设计流程工程、RTL 设计、设计验证。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“提供模拟、电源、计量与产品工程的稳定 IDM、设计平台。”
cn-shanghai-belling.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to Shanghai Belling runs through CAD Engineering, Design Flow Engineering, RTL Design, and Design Verification. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “Provides a stable IDM/design platform for analog, power, metrology, and product engineering.”

cn-china-core.descriptionZh: 国芯科技是企业，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括嵌入式 CPU、安全芯片、汽车芯片。已列出的技术重点包括自主嵌入式 CPU IP、信息安全芯片、汽车电子芯片；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-china-core.descriptionEn: China Core Technology is a company whose recorded scope includes Embedded CPUs, Security Chips, and Automotive Chips. Its listed technical focus includes proprietary embedded CPU IP, information security chips, and automotive electronic chips; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-china-core.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，国芯科技最直接的能力对应方向是 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“将处理器 IP、安全和车规 SoC 连接起来，适合软硬件联合路线。”
cn-china-core.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at China Core Technology, the most direct capability matches are RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. The recorded rationale states: “Connecting processor IP, security, and automotive-grade SoCs is suitable for the combined hardware and software route.”

cn-semidrive.descriptionZh: 芯驰科技作为企业收录于组织树，核心范围集中在汽车芯片、微控制器（MCU）、机器人。其已记录的关注点包括智能座舱 SoC、网关芯片、车控 MCU、机器人计算；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-semidrive.descriptionEn: SemiDrive is cataloged as a company centered on Automotive Chips, Microcontroller Units (MCUs), and Robotics. Its documented areas of attention include smart cockpit SoC, gateway chips, vehicle control MCUs, and robot computing; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-semidrive.relevanceZh: 筛选芯驰科技时，可先用 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“覆盖座舱、网关、车控和机器人计算，可形成车规芯片全栈能力路径。”
cn-semidrive.relevanceEn: When screening SemiDrive, use RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification as the first capability screen. Its work across cockpits, gateways, vehicle control, and robotics computing supports a full-stack automotive-chip capability path.

cn-siengine.descriptionZh: 组织树将芯擎科技归类为覆盖汽车芯片、AI 芯片、片上系统（SoC）的企业。其记录中的技术重点是智能座舱 SoC、自动驾驶芯片、端侧智能，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-siengine.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies SiEngine as a company with activity in Automotive Chips, AI Chips, and Systems-on-Chip (SoCs). Its recorded technical focus is smart cockpit SoC, autonomous driving chip, and on-device intelligence, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-siengine.relevanceZh: 芯擎科技之所以属于目标组织全集，在于 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“车规高性能 SoC 和端侧智能并重，适合架构、验证和系统软件方向。”
cn-siengine.relevanceEn: SiEngine belongs in the target universe where RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Combining automotive-grade high-performance SoC with on-device intelligence, suitable for architecture, verification, and system software directions.”

cn-caltera.descriptionZh: 加特兰微电子作为企业收录于组织树，核心范围集中在汽车芯片、毫米波雷达、射频芯片。其已记录的关注点包括 CMOS 毫米波雷达 SoC、雷达算法、车载感知；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-caltera.descriptionEn: Calterah Semiconductor is cataloged as a company centered on Automotive Chips, Millimeter-Wave Radar, and RF Chips. Its documented areas of attention include CMOS millimeter-wave radar SoC, radar algorithms, and in-vehicle sensing; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-caltera.relevanceZh: 筛选加特兰微电子时，可先用 RTL 设计、设计验证、UVM、形式验证作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“提供少见的毫米波射频、数字 SoC 与雷达算法一体化路径。”
