cn-cas-sitp.descriptionZh: 中国科学院上海技术物理研究所是研究院，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括中科院研究所、红外传感器、光电。已列出的技术重点包括红外光电探测器、成像系统、低温电子学；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-cas-sitp.descriptionEn: SITP is a research institute whose recorded scope includes Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes, Infrared Sensors, and Optoelectronics. Its listed technical focus includes infrared photodetectors, imaging systems, and cryogenic electronics; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-cas-sitp.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，中国科学院上海技术物理研究所最直接的能力对应方向是 RTL 设计、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、半导体制造。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“红外探测器、读出电路和成像系统形成器件到系统路径。”
cn-cas-sitp.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at SITP, the most direct capability matches are RTL Design, Analog Design, Custom IC Design, and Semiconductor Manufacturing. The recorded rationale states: “Infrared detectors, readout circuits, and imaging systems form the device-to-system path.”

cn-cas-xiopt.descriptionZh: 现有资料将中国科学院西安光学精密机械研究所置于研究院序列，相关活动涉及中科院研究所、光电、超快光学。更具体的组织记录指向超快光子学、光电成像、空间光学、光子器件，并由所引来源支持。
cn-cas-xiopt.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies XIOPM as a research institute active in Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes, Optoelectronics, and Ultrafast Optics. More specifically, it points to ultrafast photonics, optoelectronic imaging, spatial optics, and photonic devices, supported by the cited source.
cn-cas-xiopt.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与中国科学院西安光学精密机械研究所之间最强的连接位于模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、嵌入式系统、固件。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“覆盖超快光学、成像和光子器件，适合光电交叉研发。”
cn-cas-xiopt.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to XIOPM runs through Analog Design, Custom IC Design, Embedded Systems, and Firmware. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “Covering ultrafast optics, imaging, and photonic devices, suitable for optoelectronic cross-disciplinary research and development.”

cn-cas-ioe.descriptionZh: 现有资料将中国科学院光电技术研究所置于研究院序列，相关活动涉及中科院研究所、光电、精密控制。更具体的组织记录指向自适应光学、微细加工光学、光束控制、光电工程，并由所引来源支持。
cn-cas-ioe.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies IOE as a research institute active in Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes, Optoelectronics, and Precision Control. More specifically, it points to adaptive optics, microfabrication optics, beam control, and optoelectronic engineering, supported by the cited source.
cn-cas-ioe.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与中国科学院光电技术研究所之间最强的连接位于模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、嵌入式系统、固件。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“自适应光学与精密控制贯通控制算法、嵌入式系统和仪器工程。”
cn-cas-ioe.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to IOE runs through Analog Design, Custom IC Design, Embedded Systems, and Firmware. Adaptive optics and precision control connect control algorithms, embedded systems, and instrumentation engineering; exact openings still require separate verification.

cn-cas-aircas.descriptionZh: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院作为研究院收录于组织树，核心范围集中在中科院研究所、传感器、电子系统。其已记录的关注点包括遥感卫星、微波成像、传感器、地面系统、空天信息；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-cas-aircas.descriptionEn: AIR CAS is cataloged as a research institute centered on Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes, Sensors, and Electronic Systems. Its documented areas of attention include remote sensing satellites, microwave imaging, sensors, ground systems, and aerospace information; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-cas-aircas.relevanceZh: 筛选中国科学院空天信息创新研究院时，可先用 FPGA 工程、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、嵌入式系统作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“微波、遥感、FPGA 和复杂电子系统技术相关，但资格审查必须前置。”
cn-cas-aircas.relevanceEn: When screening AIR CAS, use FPGA Engineering, Analog Design, Custom IC Design, and Embedded Systems as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Microwave, remote sensing, FPGA, and complex electronic system technologies are related, but qualification review must be conducted in advance.”

cn-cas-nimte.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，中国科学院宁波材料技术与工程研究所被归类为研究院，公开方向覆盖中科院研究所、半导体材料、先进制造。组织资料重点提到磁性材料、新能源、功能材料、先进制造、第三代半导体，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-cas-nimte.descriptionEn: In this atlas, NIMTE is classified as a research institute working across Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes, Semiconductor Materials, and Advanced Manufacturing. The organization record emphasizes magnetic materials, new energy, functional materials, advanced manufacturing, and third-generation semiconductors, with the cited source providing the evidence basis.
cn-cas-nimte.relevanceZh: 中国科学院宁波材料技术与工程研究所与本次求职最相关的能力路径是半导体制造、设备自动化。来源记录对该组织特定匹配关系的解释为：“功能材料、制造和第三代半导体可补强实验与工程化能力。”
cn-cas-nimte.relevanceEn: NIMTE is most relevant to this search through Semiconductor Manufacturing and Equipment Automation. The source note explains the organization-specific fit this way: “Functional materials, manufacturing, and third-generation semiconductor capabilities can be enhanced by experimentation and engineering.”

cn-nanoctr.descriptionZh: 国家纳米科学中心是研究院，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括中科院研究所、纳米材料、微纳器件。已列出的技术重点包括纳米材料、器件、纳米制造、表征、标准；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-nanoctr.descriptionEn: NCNST is a research institute whose recorded scope includes Chinese Academy of Sciences Research Institutes, Nanomaterials, and Micro- and Nano-Devices. Its listed technical focus includes nanomaterials, devices, nanofabrication, characterization, and standards; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-nanoctr.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，国家纳米科学中心最直接的能力对应方向是半导体制造、设备自动化。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“国家级纳米研究平台连接材料、器件、制造和表征方法。”
cn-nanoctr.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at NCNST, the most direct capability matches are Semiconductor Manufacturing and Equipment Automation. The recorded rationale states: “A national-level nano research platform connects materials, devices, manufacturing, and characterization methods.”

cn-cetc-11.descriptionZh: 中国电科十一所是研究院，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括央国企研究院、光电、红外器件。已列出的技术重点包括红外探测器、激光器件、光电系统；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-cetc-11.descriptionEn: CETC 11th Research Institute is a research institute whose recorded scope includes State-Owned Enterprise Research Institutes, Optoelectronics, and Infrared Devices. Its listed technical focus includes infrared detectors, laser devices, and optoelectronic systems; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-cetc-11.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，中国电科十一所最直接的能力对应方向是 RTL 设计、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、半导体制造。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“覆盖红外和激光器件，但招聘与项目资格门槛必须先审查。”
cn-cetc-11.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at CETC 11th Research Institute, the most direct capability matches are RTL Design, Analog Design, Custom IC Design, and Semiconductor Manufacturing. The recorded rationale states: “Covers infrared and laser devices, but recruitment and project qualification thresholds must be reviewed first.”

cn-cetc-46.descriptionZh: 现有资料将中国电科四十六所置于研究院序列，相关活动涉及央国企研究院、半导体材料、微电子。更具体的组织记录指向半导体材料、专用材料、器件、材料检测，并由所引来源支持。
cn-cetc-46.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies CETC 46th Research Institute as a research institute active in State-Owned Enterprise Research Institutes, Semiconductor Materials, and Microelectronics. More specifically, it points to semiconductor materials, specialized materials, devices, and material testing, supported by the cited source.
cn-cetc-46.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与中国电科四十六所之间最强的连接位于可测试性设计、量产测试、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“提供电子材料、衬底和检测研究平台，须前置核验资格限制。”
cn-cetc-46.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to CETC 46th Research Institute runs through Design for Test, Production Test, Analog Design, and Custom IC Design. It provides research platforms for electronic materials, substrates, and testing, but eligibility restrictions must be checked first and exact openings still require separate verification.

cn-cetc-48.descriptionZh: 中国电科四十八所是研究院，现有记录显示其业务或研究范围包括央国企研究院、半导体设备、制造。已列出的技术重点包括半导体工艺设备、光伏、电子装备、智能制造；本档案以所引来源为依据。
cn-cetc-48.descriptionEn: CETC 48th Research Institute is a research institute whose recorded scope includes State-Owned Enterprise Research Institutes, Semiconductor Equipment, and Manufacturing. Its listed technical focus includes semiconductor process equipment, photovoltaics, electronic equipment, and intelligent manufacturing; the profile is supported by the cited source.
cn-cetc-48.relevanceZh: 面向半导体、EDA、硬件或自动化求职，中国电科四十八所最直接的能力对应方向是嵌入式系统、固件、半导体制造、设备自动化。现有记录对匹配关系的说明为：“补齐央企半导体专用装备研究与工程化平台。”
cn-cetc-48.relevanceEn: For semiconductor, EDA, hardware, or automation applications at CETC 48th Research Institute, the most direct capability matches are Embedded Systems, Firmware, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation. The recorded rationale states: “Supplement the research and engineering platform for semiconductor specialized equipment in central enterprises.”

cn-bupt-ic.descriptionZh: 组织树将北京邮电大学集成电路学院归类为覆盖高校实验室、集成电路、通信的高校实验室。其记录中的技术重点是通信集成电路、芯片设计、器件、系统，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-bupt-ic.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies BUPT IC as a university laboratory with activity in University Laboratories, Integrated Circuits, and Communications. Its recorded technical focus is communication integrated circuits, chip design, devices, and systems, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-bupt-ic.relevanceZh: 北京邮电大学集成电路学院之所以属于目标组织全集，在于 RTL 设计、模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、嵌入式系统与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“在通信、芯片与系统交叉处补充高校科研路径。”
cn-bupt-ic.relevanceEn: BUPT IC belongs in the target universe where RTL Design, Analog Design, Custom IC Design, and Embedded Systems intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Supplement university research paths at the intersection of communications, chips, and systems.”

cn-tju-microelectronics.descriptionZh: 组织树将天津大学微电子学院归类为覆盖高校实验室、微电子、集成电路的高校实验室。其记录中的技术重点是微电子器件、集成电路设计、MEMS、传感，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-tju-microelectronics.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies TJU Microelectronics as a university laboratory with activity in University Laboratories, Microelectronics, and Integrated Circuits. Its recorded technical focus is microelectronic devices, integrated circuit design, MEMS, and sensing, and the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-tju-microelectronics.relevanceZh: 天津大学微电子学院之所以属于目标组织全集，在于模拟设计、定制 IC 设计与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“覆盖电路、器件和 MEMS，连接天津制造与研究所生态。”
cn-tju-microelectronics.relevanceEn: TJU Microelectronics belongs in the target universe where Analog Design and Custom IC Design intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Covering circuits, devices, and MEMS, connecting the Tianjin manufacturing and research institute ecosystem.”

cn-nwpu-microelectronics.descriptionZh: 组织树将西北工业大学微电子学院归类为覆盖高校实验室、微电子、集成电路的高校实验室。其记录中的技术重点是集成电路设计、微电子器件、复杂电子系统，本简介以所引来源为依据。

cn-nwpu-microelectronics.relevanceZh: 西北工业大学微电子学院之所以属于目标组织全集，在于模拟设计、定制 IC 设计与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“西安芯片生态相关度高，但部分课题身份和保密限制必须前置核验。”

cn-bit-integrated-circuits.descriptionZh: 北京理工大学集成电路与电子学院作为高校实验室收录于组织树，核心范围集中在高校实验室、集成电路、电子系统。其已记录的关注点包括集成电路设计、微纳电子、电子信息系统；本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-bit-integrated-circuits.descriptionEn: BIT ICE is cataloged as a university laboratory centered on University Laboratories, Integrated Circuits, and Electronic Systems. Its documented areas of attention include integrated circuit design, micro-nano electronics, and electronic information systems; the profile is grounded in the cited source.
cn-bit-integrated-circuits.relevanceZh: 筛选北京理工大学集成电路与电子学院时，可先用模拟设计、定制 IC 设计作为能力主线。现有档案给出的理由是：“芯片与复杂电子系统结合紧密，需区分开放研究与受限课题。”
cn-bit-integrated-circuits.relevanceEn: When screening BIT ICE, use Analog Design and Custom IC Design as the first capability screen. The existing record gives this rationale: “Chips are closely integrated with complex electronic systems, requiring a distinction between open research and restricted topics.”

cn-dlut-integrated-circuits.descriptionZh: 组织树将大连理工大学集成电路学院归类为覆盖高校实验室、集成电路、微电子的高校实验室。其记录中的技术重点是集成电路设计、器件工艺、系统、封装，本简介以所引来源为依据。
cn-dlut-integrated-circuits.descriptionEn: The organization tree classifies DUT IC as a university laboratory with activity in University Laboratories, Integrated Circuits, and Microelectronics. cn-dlut-integrated-circuits.relevanceZh: 大连理工大学集成电路学院之所以属于目标组织全集，在于模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、半导体制造、设备自动化与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“补充东北地区集成电路教育、科研与产业合作路径。”
cn-dlut-integrated-circuits.relevanceEn: DUT IC belongs in the target universe where Analog Design, Custom IC Design, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “Supplementing the paths for integrated circuit education, research, and industrial cooperation in Northeast China.”

cn-szu-integrated-circuits.descriptionZh: 现有资料将深圳大学集成电路学院置于高校实验室序列，相关活动涉及高校实验室、集成电路、大湾区。更具体的组织记录指向集成电路设计、器件、先进封装、产学研合作，并由所引来源支持。
cn-szu-integrated-circuits.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies SZU IC as a university laboratory active in University Laboratories, Integrated Circuits, and Greater Bay Area. More specifically, it points to integrated circuit design, devices, advanced packaging, and industry-academia-research collaboration, supported by the cited source.
cn-szu-integrated-circuits.relevanceZh: 个人作品集与深圳大学集成电路学院之间最强的连接位于模拟设计、定制 IC 设计、半导体制造、设备自动化。具体机会仍须另行核验；研究记录指出：“地处深圳产业核心，适合寻找校企联合和工程化研究入口。”
cn-szu-integrated-circuits.relevanceEn: The strongest portfolio bridge to SZU IC runs through Analog Design, Custom IC Design, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Equipment Automation. Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “Located at the core of Shenzhen's industry, it is ideal for seeking school-enterprise collaboration and engineering research gateways.”

cn-astri.descriptionZh: 这份档案把香港应用科技研究院定位为活跃于研究院、集成电路、AI 系统的研究院。组织级证据突出集成电路、系统、通信技术、智能制造、可信 AI；这些方向不应被误读为当前在招岗位。

cn-astri.relevanceEn: Application or research-route planning for the Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute should start with RTL Design, Design Verification, UVM, and Formal Verification. ASTRI provides a Hong Kong platform for applied research and industry transfer, with projects spanning chips, communications, and systems.

cn-huawei.relevanceEn: Huawei belongs in the target universe where Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, Memory Systems, and Design for Test intersect its recorded scope. The organization-specific note reads: “The group layer covers connectivity, computing, cloud, terminals, digital energy, automotive, and basic research, serving as a system-level hardware-software collaboration entry point beyond chips.”

cn-alibaba-group.descriptionZh: 组织树将阿里巴巴集团归类为覆盖 AI 基础设施、云计算、分布式系统、研究院的企业。其记录中的技术重点是云计算、数据中心、大模型训练推理、分布式系统、数据库，本简介以所引来源为依据。

cn-alibaba-group.relevanceZh: 阿里巴巴集团之所以属于目标组织全集，在于计算机体系结构、性能分析、存储系统与其已记录范围存在交集。组织级说明写道：“阿里云与达摩院提供大规模真实负载、AI 基础设施和研究工程路径，适合系统与软硬协同方向。”
cn-alibaba-group.relevanceEn: Alibaba Group belongs in the target universe where Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, and Memory Systems intersect its recorded scope. Alibaba Cloud and DAMO Academy provide large-scale production workloads, AI infrastructure, and research-engineering paths that align with systems and hardware-software co-design.

cn-baidu.descriptionZh: 在本图谱中，百度被归类为企业，公开方向覆盖 AI 基础设施、自动驾驶、云计算、分布式系统。组织资料重点提到 AI 异构计算、大模型平台、搜索、推荐系统、百度智能云，证据基础来自所引来源。
cn-baidu.descriptionEn: In this atlas, Baidu is classified as a company working across AI Infrastructure, Autonomous Driving, Cloud Computing, and Distributed Systems. cn-baidu.relevanceEn: Baidu is most relevant to this search through Computer Architecture, Performance Analysis, Memory Systems, and Embedded Systems. Accelerator-scale AI computing, the full Baidu AI Cloud stack, and Apollo vehicle-cloud coordination provide concrete contexts for performance engineering, systems work, and autonomous-driving capabilities.

cn-oppo.descriptionEn: The existing record identifies OPPO as a company active in End-Device Systems, Embedded Technology, Computer Vision, and AI Systems. More specifically, it points to smart terminal hardware and software, imaging, ISP, on-device AI, and Android, supported by the cited source.

Exact openings still require separate verification; the research note says: “Device scale, imaging algorithms, and hardware-software collaboration are suitable for on-device AI, ISP, embedded, and system performance routes.”

The recorded rationale states: “Provides productized training for mobile devices, from low-level drivers and system performance to imaging, display, and AI implementation.”
